comments.author: guiambros
comments.story: Simple Minecraft Clone in 580 lines of Python
comments.why: Impressive demo squeezing huge content into 179KB.
comments.text: If you want to really show off the demoscene, try Farbrausch - fr-041. It's comparatively very big (179KB), but impressive how they were able to squeeze so much stuff there: video [VIDEO] , official repository: [LINK] . If you want to dig deeper, Farbrausch published most of their material and tools last year including the source code for fr-041. Search for farbrausch on GitHub. But I must say, it's pretty hardcore.

comments.author: corysama
comments.why: Demo packing audio and visuals into 200k.
comments.text: Farbrausch's "debris." shows just how much you can pack into 200k (including the audio, btw). [VIDEO] For the webby crowd: "Masagin" features animated, recursive SVGs with antialiasing and motion blur at high rez and high frame rate. [LINK] Or, you could download both demos from [LINK] and run them on your own PC.
